---
title: "Descriptive summaries"
---

## Purpose

Summarize participants, participant-days (one participant's record for one
calendar day), observations, exposure metrics, sites, and measurement
positions before fitting the hypothesis models.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: the checked datasets prepared for analysis.
- Produces: descriptive tables, components of the study overview, CSV files
  containing the exact displayed data, and a sample-flow table showing how
  many records remain after each preparation step.
- Fixed rule: every count states the stage at which it was calculated, its
  denominator, the measurement position, and the sites represented.

```{r}
#| label: setup-descriptives
#| eval: false

root <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
source(file.path(root, "scripts/pipeline/paths_io.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts/pipeline/assertions.R"))

paths <- pipeline_paths(root)
```

The completed notebook will first show brief data-quality checks and then
create the publication-ready tables, figures, and source-data files.
